sentences.text: The name Khulsanurus translates to "tail from Khulsan".
The known fossil material includes neck and tail vertebrae, shoulder bones, and leg bones.
The neck vertebrae of Khulsanurus lack pleurocoels, carotid processes, and epipophyses.
The tail vertebrae have a prominent fossa and prezygapophyses that point forward.
The genus Khulsanurus was described by Averianov and Lopatin in 2022.
Fossils of Khulsanurus were found in the Campanian Barun Goyot Formation.
Khulsanurus shared its environment with mammals like Catopsbaatar and Nemegtbaatar.
Contemporary dinosaurs included ornithischians such as Saichania, Tarchia, and Bagaceratops.
The ecosystem included the sauropod dinosaur Quaesitosaurus.
Other theropods living alongside Khulsanurus included Conchoraptor, Parvicursor, and Ceratonykus.
Khulsanurus is classified as an alvarezsaurid theropod dinosaur.
Khulsanurus belongs to the subfamily Parvicursorinae.
Khulsanurus lived between 83.6 and 72.2 million years ago during the Campanian stage.
Khulsanurus lived in the Late Cretaceous in the Gobi Desert region of Mongolia.
It is debated how Khulsanurus is related to other alvarezsaurids, with some analyses placing it in a polytomy with genera like Albinykus and Parvicursor.
